description: This file defines the LengthClass controller class within the OpenCart administrative localisation namespace. It handles CRUD operations and listing for length measurement units, including functions for displaying forms, listing existing length classes, and saving changes.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing length measurement units in the localisation module of the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of length classes with sorting, pagination, and navigation controls.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to retrieve and output the list of length classes in JSON format.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Protected method that gathers data about length classes, handles sorting, filtering, and pagination, and returns HTML view for the list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a length class.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the save request for adding or updating a length class, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more length classes based on user selection.
